helpBet: b <amount>               Bet and deal (use deal when you bank)
helpDeal: deal                     Deal the round you are banking
helpStick: s                        Stick (only on a total of 15 or more)
helpBuy: buy <amount>             Buy (raise and draw; closed after a twist)
helpSplit: sp                       Split two cards of equal rank
helpBankerTwist: bt                       Draw a card as the banker
helpBankerStay: bs                       Stop drawing and settle as the banker
dealAsBanker: You are the banker. Type deal to deal the round
bankerTurn: Your turn as banker: bt to draw, bs to stop
bankPasses: {{name}} takes the bank with a pontoon
cpuStickLine: The banker draws until {{cpuMin}} or more. A CPU seat sticks at {{min}} or more (on four cards it takes one more below {{cpuMin}}).

errBankerDoesNotBet: The banker does not place a bet.

errFiveCardTrickFull: A five card trick takes no more cards.
errHandTooLarge: The hand exceeds the maximum allowed size.
errNoHandInPlay: There is no hand in play.
errNotBankerTurn: It is not the banker's turn.
